assumptions: old_sugarloaf_dome: world.json pos y is 207.1 (the summit); the shell's pivot is the base centre (80, 18, -130) and it is generated from the terrain hill formula (18 + 190 cos^2(pi/2 q), r 72) + 0.6 clearance, so it hugs the dome. It ends at y ~21 where the dome flattens into the floor.
sunset_arch: size [16, 46, 50] read as 16 thick (X, faces west), 50 wide along Z, 46 tall; opening 30 wide x 34 high, lintel 12 thick; legs buried 2 into the Crown.

peppermint_dam: body 8 thick + pilasters/cornice to the 10-stud bbox (z -310..-300); deck at y 116 (path p_h11_h12), parapet walls to y 118 at 4..5 studs from the centre line (walkway half-width 3), iron railings on the parapets to y 119.5. Spillway slot x -10..10, lip y 108, bridged by the crest deck (deck underside y 114.5). Arched relief bays on the downstream (south) face. Peppermint bands 8 studs high. The spillway water is NOT modelled (Beams per course.md).
ranger_station: yaw -90 so the porch faces east (river/footbridge); world size [18,16,14] = depth 18 (X) x width 14 (Z).
junction_town: yaw 90 so the 5 false fronts (row 80 long, 30 deep incl. boardwalk) face west toward the plaza; shops: Candy Co., Saloon (clubhouse), Assay Office, General Store, Taffy Pull.
gondola stations: one model for both ends, yawed so the open end faces along the cable. The cable, cabin and any mid-span towers are not modelled (moving parts / out of scope).

cableway_trestles: 3 trestles on a line along Z at x -330 (z -260/-200/-140), shifted west only if they would touch a footprint or walkway; crossarm along X. The H14 swinging bucket is not built (per-hole moving part).

mine_head: not in world.json backdrop.pieces; placed at (134.0, ground, 392.0) east of H2 (>= 9 studs from its footprint), facing west. Static headframe, sheave wheel and portal only (no ore carts on rails).

lift frames: shaft (11.2 x 11.2 well, 4 corner posts, bracing on the local +-X faces only between the two boarding levels, every face open 0..10 above both landings) stands on the BOTTOM boarding point, yawed to bisect the arriving walkway and the direction to the top point; a railed gangway at the top level runs from the shaft to 1 stud past the top boarding point (railings stop 6 short of it so the departing walk can turn). Cage roof 9.5 above its floor, headframe crosshead 11.5 above the top landing (head clearance >= 8). Cage gates are left to the build (open frame).

walkway kit placement: stair flights + landings on every world.json stairs/landing segment, boardwalk planks on the Junction Boardwalk (p_h1_h2) walk segments (pieces within 2 of a footprint dropped), railing_12 runs on every walk/ramp/landing side listed in `rails` (bridges and the dam crest carry their own railings). Other walk segments stay graded terrain (Ground).

hoodoos (34), crystals (16) and cacti (72) from world.json are baked into 8 merged cluster FBXs (Taffy Mesa cacti split north/south of z 120) (one MeshPart per material each) at their exact world pos/yaw/size, so strata follow world y. Variant FBXs (hoodoo_spire_a-d, crystal_cluster_a-c, lollipop_cactus_a-c) are also exported for hand placement. Member variant = hash of the id.

Cliff/slot kit auto-placed along every terrain `set` edge and slot wall (resampled every 21.0 studs) where the real heightfield drops >= 10.0 studs, |x|,|z| <= 600.0 (the outer rim is left to terrain). Front face 3.4 studs outside the mesa edge (slot walls 0.6 inside the wall foot), base snapped down to a multiple of 6 (buried >= 0.75), stack height floor((rim-base)/6)*6 so nothing pokes above the rim. 309 stacks; skipped: {'low': 80, 'outside': 435, 'footprint': 6, 'walkway': 4}.

scatter (not in world.json): scrub, rocks and gumdrop boulders every 9-16 studs along walk/ramp/landing segments, 3-10 studs beyond the walkway edge, on flat dry ground (height range < 1 over 3 studs), >= 4 from footprints, >= 2 from walkway edges, >= 6 from lift points, not overlapping world.json scenery; kinds per zone (gumdrops on Taffy Mesa and the Crown); merged per zone.
powdered-sugar dune caps: 10 placed on flat Hoodoo Bench ground (x -600..-330), >= 6 from footprints, >= 4 from walkways, >= 18 from hoodoos (H15's own dune is a per-hole prop).

far cards: every distant_mesa / butte_spire / far_arch / far_butte is an alpha-cut bent card (<= 12 tris) yawed to face the canyon centre (world.json yaw ignored for buttes, whose local -Z didn't face the canyon); scale = [width/ref, height/ref, width/ref] (width = max(x, z) for buttes and the twin domes).
cloud streaks: 8 cards (ref 700 x 70) at r 1800-2400, y 320-620, 6 of them in the western half around the sunset.
hot-air balloons: 3 colourways x 2, start points every ~60 deg at r 520-880, y 260-420 (world.json gives only the loop ranges); the drift animation is for the build.
